newsitem.title: USA: Evergreen says will sell 3 radio stations.
newsitem.headline: Evergreen says will sell 3 radio stations.

text.p: Evergreen Media Corp said Tuesday it has agreed to sell three of its radio stations to Douglas Broadcasting/Personal Achievement Radio for $18 million.
Evergreen, which will soon become Chancellor Media Corp, said it will sell WZHF-AM and WBZS-AM in Washington, D.C., and KDFC-AM San Francisco.
The deal is scheduled to close in the third quarter and is subject to the approval of the Federal Communications Commission.
The company said the sale of the three stations to brings the new Chancellor Media Corp into compliance with FCC ownership limits.
Evergreen and Chancellor Broadcasting Co agreed in February to merge and form Chancellor Media Corp.
Evergreen also agreed to buy ten radio properties owned by Viacom International, including WZHF-AM and WBZS-AM in Washington, D.C.
Evergreen said that in order to meet FCC ownership limits, the two companies embarked on a "sales divestiture program."
Since April 8, the companies have announced station sales totaling about $436 million.
